name: GAN 11 M Duo
description: The GAN 11 M Duo 3x3 is a new, more affordable variation of their popular GAN 11 M Pro. This cube has the same construction as the famous flagship but without the magnet adjustment features. The result is an ultralight 60g cube that is $18 cheaper. Cut cost, not performance! aka: gan 11mduo Comes with: GAN 11 M Duo GAN Cube Bag Tension adjustment tool Extra tension nuts
